answer: Mechanism: maturity-locked bonds. Each key posts a stake the protocol calls a pearl, vesting only after 30 epochs of presence; the clock binds to the key's genesis signature and restarts on any split or migration, so resets cannot be parallelized. Payouts flow only from the haven escrow to keys whose pearl has vested, by protocol not review. N puppets mean N pearls frozen 30 epochs each: cost is priced per identity and grows linearly, no batch discount, while one honest pearl vests once. A juniper clause voids any pearl funding a fresh key, so abandonment burns the premium.
